title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-r05h: .tmp_check/test.rs temp file mistakenly committed
description:
Commit 592dfa85 adds .tmp_check/test.rs which is a temporary/scratch file with broken code:
- function transcript_4 is declared with 2 parameters (a, b) but called with 3 arguments (&a, &b, &c)
- The file is in .tmp_check/ which is clearly a temporary test directory
- Temp/scratch files should not be committed to the repository
- This file has no purpose in the codebase and should be removed
